record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: For integers n and d with 3 <= d <= n + 1, is every smooth degree-d hypersurface in projective space P^{n+1} K-stable?

evidence.quote:
Problem 6. For any 3 ≤ d ≤ n + 1, prove every degree d smooth hypersurface in P
n+1 is
K-stable.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ and $d$ be integers satisfying $3 \leq d \leq n+1$, and let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^{n+1}_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth hypersurface of degree $d$. Then $X$ is a Fano manifold (its anticanonical class $-K_X = (n+2-d)H|_X$ is ample, where $H$ is the hyperplane class). Recall that a Fano manifold $X$ is called K-stable if for every nontrivial test configuration $(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L})$ of $(X,-K_X)$, the generalized Donaldson–Futaki invariant $\mathrm{DF}(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{L})$ is strictly positive (equivalently, in valuative terms, $\beta(E) := A_X(E) - S_X(E) > 0$ for every prime divisor $E$ over $X$, where $A_X(E)$ is the log discrepancy and $S_X(E) = \frac{1}{(-K_X)^n}\int_0^\infty \mathrm{vol}(-K_X - tE)\,dt$).

Prove that for every pair of integers $(n,d)$ with $3 \leq d \leq n+1$, every smooth hypersurface of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{P}^{n+1}$ is K-stable.
artifact.status_search_result: The general conjecture remains open. K-stability of smooth Fano hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{P}^{n+1}$ of degree $3 \leq d \leq n+1$ has been established in several special cases: when the Fano index is 1 or 2, for general hypersurfaces, for cubic fourfolds, when the dimension is at least the cube of the Fano index, and when the Fano index is at most $n/3$. The case $d=n+1$ (index 1) follows from an alpha-invariant bound $\alpha(X) \geq n/(n+1)$. A full proof for all $(n,d)$ in this range has not been established.

status_evidence.title: K-stability of Fano varieties: an algebro-geometric approach
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture predicts that any smooth Fano hypersurface X in P^{n+1} of degree at least 3 is K-stable; known if Fano index is 1 or 2, or if X is general; known for cubic fourfolds; known if dim X is at least ι_X^3.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is open in general but established in numerous special cases.

status_evidence.title: K-stability of Fano varieties - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Smooth Fano hypersurfaces of small Fano index relative to dimension are known to be K-stable.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for low Fano index relative to dimension.
